notes.title: Update on Build August 3
notes.content:
Add support to grabble weapon: Bow and Arrow. Flexible switch between First Person Perspective and Third Person Perspective: Grabbing the Bow will switch to First Person Perspective and releasing the Bow will switch back to Third Person Perspective. Every level has default number of arrows to use, extra arrows will be rewarded for every three eggs collected.

Improve visualization of Boat jump.
